RobotExpressive

Model by Tomas Laulhe (Quaternius): https://www.patreon.com/quaternius
Modifications by Don McCurdy: https://donmccurdy.com/
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Pinned source (Three.js r180):
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive

Upstream modifications: added facial expression morph targets, converted with
FBX2GLTF, removed duplicate materials and reduced material metalness.
The local fallback PNG is rendered from the same CC0 model.
Three.js and its GLTFLoader/BufferGeometryUtils are covered by ../LICENSE.
